name: Balance Patch
author: Sanctuary Mods
description: A community balance pass, measured in game: teching up pays, commanders earn less, land costs alloys and air costs energy, engineers can be raided, commanders' missiles, artillery, bombers and anti-air hit moving targets, point defences see their range, and T2 units beat their cost in T1. Fixes a bug where one broken bomber froze other units' targeting, and aircraft can no longer fire from inside a shield at what it covers. Each section can be turned off in the lobby.

options.label: Fixes
options.description: Bugs: a bomber with no muzzles stopped other units' targeting; aircraft inside a shield's bubble hit everything under it; the Chosen T2 point defence and the EDA T3 anti-air fighter shot the ground; bombs expired before they could land; the TALEN gunship was labelled tier 1.

options.label: Economy
options.description: Commanders make 4 alloys and 45 energy a second (were 5 and 50) and T1 extractors 1.5 alloys (were 1), so expanding matters; upgrading a factory to T2 takes longer (same cost), so rushing T2 at the start does too. T2 and T3 extractors and generators give more per cost than T1; T1 generators have less health.

options.label: Unit costs
options.description: Land and naval units cost more alloys and less energy for the same total, and the AI builds less power to match. Chosen aircraft cost as much energy as the other factions'.

options.label: Engineers
options.description: Engineers have less than half their health, so raids on them work.

options.label: Commanders
options.description: The EDA and Guardian commanders' missiles fly at once and steer at where the target is going, in smaller, faster volleys: they hit moving units as often as the Chosen commander does.

options.label: Artillery
options.description: Artillery leads moving targets (it couldn't hit anything moving in a straight line); the three factions' T1 artillery are brought level.

options.label: Air
options.description: Bombers lead their targets and their bombs splash; anti-air leads its shots and the T3 anti-air towers reach their range; the Guardian fighters catch up with the others.

options.label: Defences
options.description: Point defences see as far as they shoot, and T1 point defences are tougher: they beat their cost in T1 tanks, while T1 artillery still outranges them.

options.label: Unit tuning
options.description: The Chosen Jager toned down and the other T2 raiders brought up, so T2 beats its cost in T1 without crushing it; the three T1 tanks brought level.
